name: LTM Ltd
about: Larsen & Toubro Infotech Ltd offers extensive range of IT services like application development, maintenance and outsourcing, enterprise solutions, infrastructure management services, testing, digital solutions, and platform-based solutions to the clients in diverse industries.[1]
keyPoints: Service Offerings: The company is a global technology consulting and digital solutions provider. It specializes in domain and technology expertise, offering IT services such as application development, maintenance, enterprise solutions, infra structure management, testing, analytics, artificial intelligence, and cognitive solutions.[1][2]
pros: Company has a good return on equity (ROE) track record: 3 Years ROE 23.1%
Company has been maintaining a healthy dividend payout of 42.7%
Company's working capital requirements have reduced from 33.8 days to 26.4 days

announcements.text: Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release 12 Nov - LTM's AI-QEM becomes first GSI function in IBM Quantum Functions Catalog on November 12, 2026.
Completion Of Second Term Of Mr. Sanjeev Aga As Independent Director 9 Nov - Mr. Sanjeev Aga ceased as Independent Director effective November 8, 2026, after completing second term.
Schedule Of Analyst/ Institutional Investor Call 9 Nov - LTM schedules analyst and institutional investor meetings in Mumbai on 16-18 November 2026.
Schedule Of Analyst/ Institutional Investor Call 28 Oct - LTM to hold NDR with analysts/institutional investors in Mumbai on 2 November 2026.
Announcement under Regulation 30 (LODR)-Press Release / Media Release 28 Oct - On October 28, 2026, LTM launched GCC Origin, a new independent business unit for GCC services.
